lite_server.label: wrapper-lite server URL
lite_server.description: HTTP endpoint of a running wrapper-lite instance (https://github.com/WorldObservationLog/wrapper/tree/lite), for example http://127.0.0.1:12340. It is signed in to your Apple Music account and hands out the lossless playlists and decryption keys.

alac_max.label: Maximum lossless sample rate
alac_max.description: Highest ALAC sample rate to stream. Hi-Res (96 and 192 kHz) needs much more bandwidth and decryption work.

app_token.title: Enter a developer token
app_token.description: The bundled Apple Music developer token is unavailable or expired. Paste a valid MusicKit developer token to continue.

user.title: Sign in to Apple Music
user.description: Continue to sign in with your Apple ID in a browser window. Advanced users can instead paste a Music User Token, for example for child accounts where the browser sign-in is unavailable.

auth.title: Authorize Music Assistant
auth.description: Sign in with your Apple ID in the window that opens to grant Music Assistant access.

abort.auth_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled or timed out before Apple returned a token. Please try again.

manifest.description: Stream Apple Music in lossless ALAC, decrypted in memory via a wrapper-lite instance.
